video_title: Kawhi Back to The Raptors in STUNNING Trade, LeBron's Next Team Odds + Who is the BEST in The East?

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on LeBron James' legacy and potential move to Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: His legacy is pretty much sealed, no matter where he goes. It's just a better feel-good story for me
quotes.quote: His legacy is pretty much sealed, no matter where he goes. It's just a better feel-good story for me if he ended up in Cleveland.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on Kawhi Leonard leaving money on the table in San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: He left a lot of money on the table and, you know what I'm saying, was a guy
quotes.quote: I'm not saying he left crazy. He left San Antonio in a different way, but he left a lot of money on the table and, you know what I'm saying, was a guy that obviously, yeah, back and forth.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce notes Ja Morant's absence from consecutive NBA games
quotes.excerpt: Ja Morant has not played in six consecutive NBA games
quotes.quote: Ja Morant has not played in six consecutive NBA games. I wouldn't have never guessed that.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre announces Kawhi Leonard trade to the Toronto Raptors
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers sent Kawhi Leonard to the Toronto Raptors for Brandon Ingram, Grady Dick, two first-round picks
quotes.quote: The Clippers sent Kawhi Leonard to the Toronto Raptors for Brandon Ingram, Grady Dick, two first-round picks in the future, one pick swap, two second-rounders.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green reacts to Kawhi Leonard's return to Toronto
quotes.excerpt: When I first heard the news that he wanted to go back, it was kind of weird
quotes.quote: When I first heard the news that he wanted to go back, it was kind of weird to digest at first. I'm like, this can't be real. I love that he's there now, but when I first heard, I'm like, there's no way he like he left.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce evaluates Toronto's potential as an Eastern Conference contender
quotes.excerpt: If Kawhi Leonard gives you the season that he had this past year and gives it to Toronto
quotes.quote: If Kawhi Leonard gives you the season that he had this past year and gives it to Toronto, who is very competitive in the playoffs, a team that took Cleveland to seven games. They took them to Cleveland to seven games. That's right. And if you get that version of Kawhi and a healthy guy throughout the season with question marks surrounding Boston, with question marks surrounding Detroit, Cleveland, pretty much everybody but New York Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green emphasizes Toronto's need for a solid big man
quotes.excerpt: They just need a solid big, like big. You trying to match up with KAT and Joel and those guys
quotes.quote: They just need a solid big, like big. You trying to match up with KAT and Joel and those guys if they're healthy and a Jokic or Wembanyama. Like if you come out the East, you just need a solid like Collin Murray-Boyles. I love his game, young, CMB, but they need another one.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce predicts the Eastern Conference hierarchy
quotes.excerpt: I just think teams are going to be better. They're not better than Orlando right now
quotes.quote: I just think teams are going to be better. They're not better than Orlando right now. Orlando gave me an impressive showing in the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre discusses LeBron James' announcement to the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James has informed the Los Angeles Lakers on Tuesday the franchise can move on about their business
quotes.quote: LeBron James has informed the Los Angeles Lakers on Tuesday the franchise can move on about their business. 'Cause I'm not coming back.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green questions if the Lakers need to patch things up with LeBron
quotes.excerpt: Is there a chance, any chance in the world, where they need him and they like try to patch
quotes.quote: Is there a chance, any chance in the world, where they need him and they like try to patch things up?

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre quotes Jeanie Buss on LeBron James' legacy
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James is one of the greatest athletes in history. We will always be thankful for his eight
quotes.quote: LeBron James is one of the greatest athletes in history. We will always be thankful for his eight years with the Lakers, including the title he led us to in 2020 under the toughest imaginable circumstances and the countless records he broke in purple and gold.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on LeBron James controlling his own narrative
quotes.excerpt: LeBron throughout his career has always controlled his own narrative and it just seems like
quotes.quote: LeBron throughout his career has always controlled his own narrative and it just seems like kind of like the same situation he kind of dealt with in Miami. Felt underappreciated. You know what I'm saying? Like he brought them a championship and felt underappreciated for what he did for the franchise and rightfully so because he he raised the level and he puts you in contention whenever wherever he goes.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce suggests LeBron James should finish his career in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: I think that's like he should go here, finish his career off where it started
quotes.quote: I think that's like he should go here, finish his career off where it started, where he brought the first championship, and it puts him in contention.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the potential of a LeBron James, James Harden, and Donovan Mitchell team
quotes.excerpt: If you put LeBron James with James Harden and Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen
quotes.quote: If you put LeBron James with James Harden and Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen, and you know, I don't know if you can keep Evan Mobley and Allen, you can keep one of them though. Yeah, I mean when you bring LeBron in, depending on his price tag, because clearly the price tag that he wasn't LA wasn't willing to pay, so that has to tell you like what type of price tag will he take less to be somewhere else.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre discusses the Memphis Grizzlies trading for Ja Morant
quotes.excerpt: On Monday the Portland Trail Blazers took a shot, traded for Ja Morant. They traded Jeremy Grant
quotes.quote: On Monday the Portland Trail Blazers took a shot, traded for Ja Morant. They traded Jeremy Grant and Chris Murray to the Grizzlies to complete the deal.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre notes Ja Morant's franchise records in Memphis
quotes.excerpt: He got two All-Stars and All-NBA second team, Rookie of the Year, all rookie first team, most improved
quotes.quote: He got two All-Stars and All-NBA second team, Rookie of the Year, all rookie first team, most improved, franchise record for most points ever scored in a game. This guy was the clear face of the franchise, clearly the future of the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Ja Morant's impact and the Grizzlies' culture reset
quotes.excerpt: The Memphis Grizzlies trying to reset their culture and build through the draft
quotes.quote: The Memphis Grizzlies trying to reset their culture and build through the draft. And on the other side, you give Ja Morant some fresh air to re-go to Portland and reinvent himself, you know, with a young team, a talented team, that can go to the playoffs next year.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Grizzlies' roster depth
quotes.excerpt: I think they got to trade, you know, some of these other guards they have. I don't think
quotes.quote: I think they got to trade, you know, some of these other guards they have. I don't think they're going anywhere. So I think the odd man out is probably Drew Holiday and Scoot.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Grizzlies' backcourt being the most downhill in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I like this move for Portland. I mean, we're going to look at a backcourt that's probably going to
quotes.quote: I like this move for Portland. I mean, we're going to look at a backcourt that's probably going to be the most downhill backcourt you're going to see in the NBA when you talk about guys who attack the basket with these two guys and put pressure on the defense and they're young.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Lakers' lack of depth and defensive issues
quotes.excerpt: They lost Dean Wade. That's not the answer. Well, the Lakers are really bad that year, no?
quotes.quote: They lost Dean Wade. That's not the answer. Well, the Lakers are really bad that year, no? They didn't make the playoffs. They didn't make the playoffs. No, yeah, and it'll be the same with Golden State. The Golden State Warriors would not make the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's trade to the Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: It's a good move for Ja to be able to get out of Memphis.
quotes.quote: It's a good move for Ja to be able to get out of Memphis. Now both sides can move on. Memphis can move on and Ja can move on.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland Trail Blazers' lack of direction and core
quotes.excerpt: The thing about Portland is they have a direction now. They have a core.
quotes.quote: The thing about Portland is they have a direction now. They have a core. Think about some of these teams that don't have no direction, don't have no core. They are just throwing pieces out there and still trying to figure it out.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's potential for a career turnaround
quotes.excerpt: I'm rooting for Ja to turn this thing around.
quotes.quote: I'm rooting for Ja to turn this thing around. To me, he was one of my favorite players to watch as he was ascending. I think he was one of the most creative players, intuitive, and just having a great feel for the game.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: The lack of basketball understanding in younger players
quotes.excerpt: A lot of these newer kids, it's all trainer work, it's all skill work.
quotes.quote: A lot of these newer kids, it's all trainer work, it's all skill work. Which we get it, you can make a jump shot, you can make a thousand jump shots in open gym. You got all the footwork, hesi, all of that stuff that you do with your trainer, but a lot of that stuff it don't translate into understanding how to just play basketball. And Ja Morant was one of the few guys coming up his age where it's just like, oh, this guy has creativity to his game.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Robinson's lack of motivation for the team
quotes.excerpt: I credit that to just being unmotivated for a franchise toward the end.
quotes.quote: I credit that to just being unmotivated for a franchise toward the end. He wasn't there mentally. They turned their back on him.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Critique of the NBA Cup location choice
quotes.excerpt: I'm not a fan of it. I like Vegas for pick one spot.
quotes.quote: I'm not a fan of it. I like Vegas for pick one spot. Or if you're going to do a spot, do the spots that you think you're going to expand to.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA Cup should be held in a more attractive city
quotes.excerpt: We got to find a sexier city, like a nicer place that people are more attractive to.
quotes.quote: We got to find a sexier city, like a nicer place that people are more attractive to. It's going to be cold as shit, bro. We got to bring out Canada Geese.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Indiana's deep basketball history
quotes.excerpt: Indiana does have a deep rich basketball history. We know that.
quotes.quote: Indiana does have a deep rich basketball history. We know that. So like it would be like, all right, we're having it in Indiana this year, maybe we'll do it in Kansas or the fall, exactly. Cameron Indoor. You understand? Something like that. These places are historical for basketball.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA Cup should remain in NBA cities
quotes.excerpt: I think NBA should stay because like these colleges are like in the middle of nowhere.
quotes.quote: I think NBA should stay because like these colleges are like in the middle of nowhere and it's surrounded by mostly college fans.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Scheduling concerns for the NBA Cup
quotes.excerpt: Don't make the championship and the semi-finals four days apart.
quotes.quote: Don't make the championship and the semi-finals four days apart. Just be like, we're pushing the game, the one game, two weeks. Give the fans of the teams a chance to book travel to Las Vegas.
